'''Anthony Milner Lane''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|FRS}} (1928–2011) was a leading theoretical [[nuclear physicist]] who had a career in the Theoretical Physics Division at the [[Atomic Energy Research Establishment|Atomic Energy and Research Establishment (AERE)]] at Harwell.

He was elected Fellow of the [[Royal Society]] in 1975.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Clement|first=Charles|date=2020|title=Anthony Milner Lane. 27 July 1928—9 February 2011|url=https://royalsocietypublishing.org/doi/10.1098/rsbm.2019.0044|journal=Biographical Memoirs of Fellows of the Royal Society}}</ref>
